verdict.oneLineSummary: Requires a dedicated HubSpot Developer Account; standard multi-tenant app review takes ~1-2 weeks.

twoClocks.worksInDev: ~20 min (via a free Developer Test Account)
twoClocks.anyUserCanConnect: 7–14 days (Marketplace listing review for public unlisted install)

cost: Free developer account. Paid subscriptions required for custom objects or high API limits.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent create and update CRM contacts, deals, and companies?
capabilityCheck.detail: HubSpot provides rich CRM REST endpoints. However, custom object endpoints require the connecting user's HubSpot portal to be on Enterprise or Pro tiers.

prerequisites: A HubSpot Developer Account (separate from standard user accounts)
A Developer Test Account portal created inside your dev portal

steps.text: Sign up for a dedicated Developer Account at developers.hubspot.com.

fields.name: Account type
fields.note: Must create a Developer portal, not a normal sales portal.

steps.text: Go to Apps → Create app → Auth Settings.

fields.name: Scopes
fields.note: Pick minimal CRM scopes (e.g. crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.contacts.write). Requesting admin scopes triggers extended security reviews.

steps.text: Create a Developer Test Account under Testing tab to test install.
steps.note: You cannot test install an unlisted app in your developer portal; you must install it into a child Test Portal.

blockers.issue: Attempting to test install an app inside the primary Developer Account produces an 'App cannot be installed in this account' error.
blockers.workaround: Create a dedicated 'Test Account' from within the Developer console dashboard and install the app there.

composio.recommendation: Composio provides managed HubSpot auth and pre-built CRM actions for instant agent operations.

evidence.claim: HubSpot requires apps to be installed into separate test accounts during development and mandates marketplace review for multi-tenant distribution.
evidence.label: SOURCED
